key.name: repository-location
key.description: Local path of the Borg repository. Empty means not configured yet.

key.name: repository-id
key.description: The identifier of the repository that Delta made or adopted, to notice when a different one is found at the same place. Empty until the first backup after it was set up.

key.name: backup-sources
key.description: Absolute paths of the folders to back up. Empty means the whole home folder.

key.name: excluded-paths
key.description: Absolute paths that are not backed up, with everything inside them. Added to the built-in exclusions (cache and trash).

key.name: schedule
key.description: systemd OnCalendar expression used by the delta.timer drop-in.

key.name: keep-hourly
key.description: Retention policy passed to borg prune (--keep-hourly).

key.name: keep-daily
key.description: Retention policy passed to borg prune (--keep-daily).

key.name: keep-weekly
key.description: Retention policy passed to borg prune (--keep-weekly).

key.name: keep-monthly
key.description: Retention policy passed to borg prune (--keep-monthly).
